Janel Hawkins, founder of Sand Castle University, transforms compacted sand into detailed sculptures, from elaborate castles to animals and imaginative characters. Carving away small sections and smoothing each surface, she gradually turns a simple mound into shapes with surprisingly crisp edges and intricate details. The process is mesmerizing to watch, especially knowing how temporary the finished work is. Each sculpture takes patience and precision, even though the sand will eventually lose its shape. by Nie Shichang. Created as his 2025 graduation project at the China Academy of Art, The Cyclic Apparatus is a kinetic sculpture featuring two fish inspired by the Tai Chi yin-yang symbol. The attention you've given me these last 3 years has been vital to getting over my fears, messing around more, and taking bigger risks. I won't give you all the credit, I'm proud of myself for trying things, for keeping at it, for letting belief in myself overcome the doubt. But you gave me evidence to back up my confidence, and I thank you! None of us stand alone right?  So I find myself now here: I am publicly asking you to purchase my art.
